'''Master of the Order''', or '''Mistress of the Order''', also called the '''Master''' or '''Mistress of the Baran Do''', was a title used to denote the leading Master of the [[Baran Do]] sages.

==History==
In [[34 ABY/Legends|34 ABY]], then-[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] traveled to the Baran Do sages on [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]]. He was taught several [[Force power/Legends|Force techniques]] by their current Master of the Order, [[Koro Ziil]]. Around [[43 ABY]], Ziil joined the [[Hidden Ones]], and by the time of the [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] visit later in the year, [[Tila Mong]] had become Mistress of the Order.
